name: document-extraction-funnel-site-root
description: Full-stack Document Extraction Funnel Site with React 18 frontend, Node.js Express backend, and SQL (SQLite) lead database

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
